text: Spin-off: "cross-repo link at the seam" option
description: Deferred remainder of the basic spin-off. Instead of dropping connections that cross the seam (a copied aim that supported an ancestor left behind in the source, e.g. B->A), offer a dialog option to preserve them as cross-repo links (repoId-tagged edges, see 5a45cb28) so the spun-off branch stays connected to what it used to serve. Postponed until basic spin-off + cross-repo edges land.

status.comment: Cancelled 2026-09-20: preserving a spin-off seam edge B→A means pointing at ancestor aim A inside the source repo — an aim-level target. Under black-box links a spun-off repo can only say 'the source repo as a whole supports me', which is a plain repo link the user can add by hand after the spin-off.

reflection: Cancelled, not parked: the seam-preservation premise is aim-level. The whole-repo fallback needs no dedicated feature — it is the ordinary registry + link-repo flow.
